notes.title: Korea Dynasty September 2025 development roadmap
notes.notes: [p]We present the September 2025 development roadmap. This month’s roadmap reflects the majority of user feedback, with many updates focusing on optimization, graphic improvements, and sub-content. Compared to previous months, we have prepared a slightly larger number of updates.[/p][hr][/hr][h3](Content / System)[/h3][list][*][p]Change to allow equipping both axe and shield simultaneously[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-games to be used in the Military Exam[/p][/*][*][p]Secret royal inspectors may appear while performing official duties[/p][/*][*][p]New stat: when managing multiple companions, costs decrease or duration increases[/p][/*][*][p]Horses take fall damage and dismount if falling from high places[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of various side missions[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of [i]Seungja Chongtong[/i] (Joseon hand cannon)[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of fire arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Special skills added to negotiations[/p][/*][*][p]New building types added[/p][/*][*][p]Limit of maximum 5,000 buildings per district in each region[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of Yeon-gyetang and adjustment of quest requirements[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced hitbox damage while rolling[/p][/*][*][p]Changed so that players can enter small, medium, and large castles while mounted.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding a torch reduces cold effects[/p][/*][*][p]New stat added to increase health[/p][/*][*][p]Additional agenda types added for official positions[/p][/*][*][p]Contribution increases when completing side missions near the castle while holding an official position.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3](Convenience / Optimization / Graphics)[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted boss animations to look more natural when falling and standing up[/p][/*][*][p]Props added so nighttime agenda meetings appear more natural[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized resources used in map UI[/p][/*][*][p]Partial optimization of Hanyang Fortress[/p][/*][*][p]Roof tile graphics updated and optimized[/p][/*][*][p]Added natural-looking walls to some shops[/p][/*][*][p]Improved and optimized tree models in the field[/p][/*][*][p]Item memory optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Partial NPC memory optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Shields not equipped during meetings[/p][/*][*][p]Improved impact feedback for blunt weapons such as clubs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where rain appeared in mines[/p][/*][*][p]Made number of agendas handled by players more visible in office view[/p][/*][*][p]Changed map hint icons[/p][/*][*][p]Improved outdated UI[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3](Objects)[/h3][list][*][p]Multiple ruins added[/p][/*][*][p]Citizen shops and artificial objects can now catch fire[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3](NPC / Factions)[/h3][list][*][p]Bandits carrying torches added[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum NPC limit in faction rushes[/p][/*][*][p]Some NPCs can attack or destroy neutral buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced maximum favorability with bandits/secret gangs[/p][/*][*][p]In faction rushes, more enemies appear depending on number of companions[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs equipped with shields added[/p][/*][*][p]Mounted NPCs added[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3](Balance)[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted so horses tire less quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the amount of [i]Sangpyeong Tongbo[/i] (currency) required to enter castle gates[/p][/*][*][p]Increased item weight for crafting tables and similar objects[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]In addition, bug fixes and detailed improvements will continue to be implemented.[/p][p]Your Steam recommendations and positive reviews are a vital driving force for the continued development of our game. We sincerely thank you.[/p][p]While we may not be able to accept every suggestion due to different directions or development difficulty, we always select and reflect a certain number of opinions from the official Discord when setting our monthly roadmap.[/p][p]This game is created with passion and dedication. Although it is not a AAA title, we will continue to add diverse and fun content and improve shortcomings during the Early Access period so that our game leaves you with good memories and experiences.[/p]

notes.title: Korea Dynasty 0.9.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/430480cf516ba7504f8464b0e1d0757e2bf1f7f4.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bangbangbok Eosahwa outfit has been added.
[*] Bangbangbok Danryeong outfit has been added.
[*] Bangbangbok Bottoms outfit has been added.
[*] Bangbangbok Shoes outfit has been added.
[/list]
*Can be obtained as a reward for passing the Jeonsi exam or purchased from the black market merchant.

[h2]System[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Jeonsi state exam has been added. If the requirements are met, you can talk to the Entrance Officer NPC in front of Gwanghwamun at Gyeongbokgung to take the exam.
[*] The Official Rank system has been added. After passing the Jeonsi, you can be appointed to a castle through the Ijo Jeollang.
[*] As a magistrate, you can now conduct meetings and trials. By accumulating contribution, you can be promoted.
[*] A finance stat has been added to castles.
[*] Constables and bounty hunters can now be hired as combat companions.
[/list]

[h2]Animals/NPC[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Ijo Jeollang NPC has been added. Can be found at Yukjo Street in front of Gwanghwamun, Gyeongbokgung.
[*] The Chaekgaek NPC has been added. Can be found in the Podocheong of castles.
[*] The Hyangni NPC has been added. Can be found inside castles.
[*] Constable bounty dialogue now changes depending on the player’s official rank.
[*] Some negotiation dialogue has been updated.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the chance and amount of feathers obtained when hunting birds.
[*] Negotiation difficulty has been slightly reduced.
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] When becoming a noble or receiving an official rank, related information is now displayed in the Status/Fame tab.
[*] Tips related to the state exam have been added to the loading screen.
[/list]

[h2]Optimization/Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Physics calculations for hit detection have been optimized.
[/list]

[h2]User Convenience[/h2]
[list]
[*] An ‘Official Rank’ section has been added to the Help menu.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs could be imprisoned in the wrong castle when multiple castles were nearby.
[*] Fixed an issue where the map icon was not displayed correctly when a companion was in prison.
[*] Fixed an issue where companions would stop if the player left a castle while they were taking damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where hunger/thirst decreased during the tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue where the remaining water in multiple waterskins placed in quickslots was not synchronized correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the inventory could be opened while using an item.
[*] Fixed an issue where hit detection disappeared for certain items.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs could teleport below the terrain in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the action UI was displayed incorrectly while mounted.
[*] Fixed an issue where placeable items could be placed while mounted.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain NPCs in Hanyang would disappear abnormally.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs using throwing blades could sometimes revive after death.
[*] Improved an issue where NPCs blocked each other’s paths in castles or Hanyang.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where starting items were not given on first entry in multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: Korea Dynasty 0.8.70 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/42c184ea3ac88fe7f126187ebbdf6ddd2cbfb154.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controls for using a sword and shield simultaneously have been improved to feel more natural.
[/list]

[h2]System[/h2]
[list]
[*] If the player is in a location inaccessible to NPCs, NPCs will now attempt to jump or attack.
[*] Some NPC gift-related dialogue has been consolidated.

[list]
[*] A side mission has been added to the constable in charge of surrenders at the police office.
[/list]

[h2]Animals/NPCs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Animal movement animations have been made more natural.
[*] Companions can now be hired up to a maximum of five, based on reputation.
[*] Companions will continue to follow the player even if they fall down during movement.

[*] The constable in charge of surrenders at the castle is now saved properly.

[list]
[*] The key to plant seeds during farming has been changed to left-click.

[/list]

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]Saving[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]User Convenience[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Roadmap February to March 2025
notes.notes:
We present a roadmap for development from February to March 2025.

The February-March roadmap focuses on increasing detailed convenience and completeness of the game, and updates will be made with content in the direction of slightly increasing the degree of freedom of the game.

(Content/System)

[olist]
[*] Injury function by body part
[*] Natural and man-made functions of injury
[*] Add negotiation function or usage
[*] Added the ability to fall from a horse
[*] Added collision function in the event of a horse's charge
[*] In prison, player talks to pozzol
[*] Add less durable capability
[*] Change the initial jangseung quest to an architectural quest
[/olist]

(Item/Architecture)
[olist]
[*] Add some outfits
[*] Weight-weighting function of bag or forklift items
[/olist]

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
[olist]
[*] Improvements to variously adjust the blocking angle of the sword
[*] Diversify the sword's attack motion depending on the direction of attack
[*] Improve difficulty systems and add options
[*] Provide power relationship UI
[*] Intuitively change some of the hard-to-identify icons
[*] Reorganize the UI to make it easier to see when there is less stamina/hunger/thirsty
[*] Provide the values of the relationship as a numerical value
[*] Controller official support
[*] Add sound effects to distinguish when a product is damaged
[*] Resizing the cursor
[*] Increase notification time for acquisition of goods
[*] Change the button UI text of the installation item so that it is not difficult to distinguish it
[*] National Map UI displays a description of the absence of a compass
[/olist]

(Ji-Ji-Mi)
[olist]
[*] Addition of den or base of the sword forces
[*] Serving medium-sized castles
[/olist]

(NPC/Power)
[olist]
[*] Adding animal AI patterns
[*] Allow NPCs to be trapped in grapevine as well
[*] An event in which friendly or neutral NPCs occasionally visit players
[*] Adjust the relationship to be a little more generous when it comes to the tavern NPC
[/olist]

(Balance)
[olist]
[*] Add fame every time you draw a map
[*] Add fame every time you discover a historical site
[*] Adjust the top leader to have more high-end items or top-level notifications
[*] Lower the speed at which enemy npc evades back immediately after attack
[*] Increase the speed of running with bare hands
[/olist]

(Multiplayer)
[olist]
[*] Make the reason more specific in the event of an error
[/olist]

Likewise, as in previous roadmaps, bug fixes will be carried out at all times.

Steam recommendations and positive re-evaluation are a huge boost for the ongoing development of our game. Thank you very much.

Depending on the direction of the game or the difficulty of development, we may not be able to accept all players' opinions, but our game always selects and reflects a certain amount of opinions from the official Discord when we set a roadmap every month.

As it is a game that is planned and produced with affection, we will add various fun contents and make up for the shortcomings during the early access period so that we can leave you with good memories and memories, even if it is not a AAA-class game.

notes.title: Development Roadmap for January 2025
notes.notes:
We present a roadmap for development in January 2025.

January Roadmap wants to add convenience for players starting the game for the first time, rearrange help, require players to have more realistic weight management through weight systems, and to compensate for some penalties, increase basic movement speeds and overlap limits on things.

Other npcs will now have the plaque that occurred in the existing unexpected mission.

And we want to create an outdoor base for external forces that players wanted. Outdoor bases can be used or invaded depending on your choice and relationship.

(Content/System)

[olist]
[*] Change the majority of NPCs to drop a plaque at a certain probability upon death

notes.title: Development Roadmap for December 2024
notes.notes:
We present a roadmap for development in December 2024.

This road map aims to improve and develop in a balanced way in various parts in a short period of time. In particular, it included shields and stone throwing and AI improvements for the diversity of combat parts that users wanted most, and a pickpocket function will be added to increase the degree of freedom of the game.

In the long run, we would like to introduce a negotiation system to realize the main direction we aim for. Currently, in the Joseon Metasilok, negotiations are only used in small areas like bargaining, so users who wanted colorful content may be disappointed, but for high degrees of freedom, we would like to develop it to verify its usability and develop it as an essential part of the core functions for solving complex and diverse relationships between NPCs and forces.

In addition, as with previous roadmaps, we plan to provide useful tips and alerts to make it easier for new users to adapt to the game, and we will also improve convenience.


(Content/System)
1. Negotiation (negotiation) capabilities based on different skill levels against NPCs
2. In the introduction and defense of the shield system, the target area is changed to the actual defense area
3. Added auxiliary weapon (shield) slot for belongings
4. Add player's pickpocket feature
5. improvement of the hiding system
6. Add swimming capabilities and use a stemina to cross the river, adjust to create hazards and crisis factors


(Item/Architecture)
1. Improvements to throw stones
2. Add Shield Items


(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Improve map convenience and add functionality
2. Improve the Defense UI
3. Change inconsistent design in title menu
4. Font Memory Optimization
5. Tips and cautions on the right for users who may be unaware of the functionality
6. Improved tutorial convenience and auxiliary UI
7. Improved convenience for controller users
8. Increase overall brightness over time
9. Improvements to ensure that historic sites-related missions have been completed
10. Axing improves the sense of hit
11. Slightly reduce the amount of time to move after the attack motion
12. Show tooltips to make it easier to understand what mounting slots are like
13. Modify the counterpart name when exchanging inventory


(Ji-Ji-Mi)
1. Add some historical sites
2. Slightly higher building restrictions (33,000 units)
* There is already a high risk of minimum specifications due to the limit, but we would like to make some adjustments because we believe that there are many people who have built many buildings.


(NPC/Power)
1. Addition to save hostages in some den etc
2. Religious NPCs Arrange to Improve Relations in Power Relations
3. Some NPCs may throw stones
4. Dress changes to make it easier to guess the forces of some NPCs
5. Clarify the vague occupations of NPCs
6. Diversification of attack patterns for some NPCs
7. Make it easier to understand if there is a feature in the NPC conversation


(Balance)
1. Adjustment of supply and demand for specialties with little benefit
2. Increasing the amount of time you spend sleeping
3. When you run out of hunger, your physical strength is reduced less than before, so you can live longer
4. Change the vital skills to make it harder for them to rise a little more
5. Main mission rewards provide standing notifications instead of some items so inventory is not complicated in the beginning
6. It's fast to roll and raises it to have less stemina
7. Increase burn damage
8. Change the sightings of players pre-empting NPCs to be perceived as more hostile
9. Adjustment to produce crops that may not be harvested at the beginning, depending on the harvest level
10. Adjust the required level of the water heater and jar to level 2
11. Change the ingredients required for the water heater
12. Increase the reference point for holding the axe to allow for a slightly wider range
13. Reduce the durability of the demolition function


(Multiplayer)
1. Display a message over the character's head when chatting


Likewise, as in previous roadmaps, bug fixes will be carried out at all times.

Steam recommendations and positive re-evaluation are a huge boost for the ongoing development of our game. Thank you very much.

As it is a game that is planned and produced with affection, we will add fun content and make up for the shortcomings during the early access period so that we can leave you with good memories and memories, even if it is not a AAA-class game.

notes.title: Korea Dynasty Development Roadmap for November 2024
notes.notes:
We present a roadmap for development in November 2024.

This road map focuses on improving the visual elements of the game, which have been a bit awkward for a short time, and adding convenience features that minority players need. It will also improve the power relationship system to further clarify the relationship between forces so that it can provide a somewhat complex but diverse range of features.

Currently, our roadmap focuses on improvements that Korean users want on Steam bulletin boards and Discord. However, we want it to be a good game for global users, so if there is a direction we want, we will actively reflect it. Please suggest to us. We will reflect any good opinions as soon as possible. Thank you.

(Content/System)
1. Gamepad/controller support
2. Add new performances
3. Adding quality steps to the tool
4. Add more homes available for purchase in a large scale
5. Diversification and Improvement of Combat Mechanisms in General NPCs
6. Addition of a power relationship change system based on player behavior
7. Add a Fisherman Fellow
8. Improvements to allow colleagues to enter and exit the castle together
9. Add an unexpected mission

(Item/Architecture)
1. Add some weapon items
2. Add some decorative items
3. Add some ingredients and food items
4. Add a bucket
5. Limiting the maximum number of buildings to prevent overuse of resources (30 to 40,000 units)
6. Easy to change the ingredients for making skewers

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Provide UI to check NPC's information during conversation with NPC
2. Add automatic extinction to prevent NPC from holding exchanged items for a long time
3. Improve convenience so that researchable items are clearly distinguished in the Research tab
4. Improvements to ensure relevant capability figures are available on the production platform
5. Optimizing Player Costume Memory
6. Optimizing full modeling and placing empty spaces naturally
7. Add an alert UI when inefficiently purchasing (when all of them are purchased) specialties

(Ji-Ji-Mi)
1. Add Dolharbang to Jeju Island
2. Improving gender submodeling
3. Place stones and rocks around the castle naturally
4. Add Historic Site

(NPC/Power)
1. Add a Combatable NPC belonging to the top
2. Adding hostile responses from farmers' NPCs

(Balance)
1. Penalties are given to foods that are easy to obtain or make, and benefits to foods that are more difficult to produce


Steam recommendations and positive re-evaluation are a huge boost for the development of our game. Thank you very much.

As it is a game that is planned and produced with affection, we will add fun content and make up for the shortcomings during the early access period so that we can leave you with good memories and memories, even if it is not a AAA-class game.

notes.title: Development Roadmap for September-October 2024
notes.notes:
Here is the development roadmap for September-October 2024. (Content/System)
1. Can enter Gyeongbokgung Palace in Hanyang
2. Added Podocheong cutscene
3. Changed Podocheong function to work inside Hanyang
4. Changed so that players can perform (NPC interaction)
5. Improved movement to evade NPC attacks during battle to make it slightly easier
6. Each NPC has a chance to have a religion
7. Added difficulty setting option
8. Added surprise mission
9. Improved relationship recovery mechanism (so that bad relationships with NPCs can be improved a little faster than before)
10. Improved force rush system
11. Changed seasonal cycle to 1 month (in game time)
12. Purchase land and houses inside the castle

(Item/Building)
1. Added some weapon items
2. Added some costume items
3. Added some decorative items

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Improved warning when forces such as Chuno chase the player
2. Optimized texture memory for thatched and tiled houses

(Objects)
1. China Implementation of regional boundaries and terrain
*If you cross the boundary, a warning message will be displayed and you will be unable to enter. Since it was previously the sea, you can see that this part has been modified to be a bit more realistic.

2. Implementation of the Amnok River and the Duman River
3. Overall reduction in the height of steep mountains, including those in North Korea
*The location of existing structures built on some high mountains may appear unnatural.

(NPC/force)
1. Provide conversation motion when talking to NPCs
2. Add NPCs inside Gyeongbokgung Palace
3. Add Shaman NPC
4. Add Manchurian deserter NPC

(Balance)
1. Adjust required experience points by ability range
2. Provide penalties for easy-to-obtain or make food, and benefits for foods with high production difficulty

In addition, we will continue to fix bugs and improve convenience.

This roadmap was decided with a focus on players who may want more additional content after the main quest. In particular, we aimed to reflect regional differences to some extent through land/house purchases inside the castle where you can use the money you've saved, access to the inside of Gyeongbokgung Palace, which can be seen as a slightly different attraction of Hanyang Castle, and special NPCs in the North Korean region like the Japanese merchants that were created previously.

Even though it's still lacking, I would like to sincerely thank those who have always enjoyed the game and supported and promoted it.
I would also like to express my deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who recommended and gave good reviews on Steam. I remember you.
Since it's a game that we made with love, planned, and created, we will add fun content and make up for the shortcomings during the remaining period so that it can remain as a good memory and recollection, even if it's not a AAA game.

notes.title: Development roadmap for July and August 2024
notes.notes:
We present a development roadmap for July and August 2024.

(Content/System)
1. You can hire up to two colleagues
2. Add miner companions
3. Add farmer companions
4. Changed so you can take your companions to the dungeon
5. Add challenges
6. Improved secondary mission system
7. When demolishing a building with a hammer, some resources are returned.
8. Added shovel function
9. Changed so that animals run away when firing a rifle.
10. Added ability to increase stamina recovery speed
11. Modification and improvement of key mission text
12. Reputation value increases when freeing a captured NPC
13. If you bow to tomb-related historical sites, Confucianism and other abilities increase.
14. Changed so that relationships can be restored in villages

(Item/Construction)
1. Add some weapon items
2. Added some clothing items
3. Add some decorative items
4. Add or adjust ingredients that cannot be made in the current recipe or are difficult to obtain.

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Improvements so that some tools can be held longer
2. Added notification message when a crafting recipe is unlocked
3. Health display in boss battles
4. Improvement of some item descriptions
5. Reorganization of some ability categories
6. Changed some ability descriptions
7. Improved research convenience
8. Changed so that some collected items can be eaten raw.

(feature)
1. Add top store inside Hanyang
2. Slightly increases the probability of a well being created.

(NPC/force)
1. Add NPC types
2. Reorganization of items sold by some NPCs

(balance)
1. Improved effect of herbal medicine
2. Changes in crops produced depending on the season
3. Increased probability of horse spawning
4. Slight improvement in basic walking speed

In addition to this, we will continue to fix bugs and improve convenience.
As more content has been added, there are bugs in multiplayer. Let's try to solve it.

This roadmap organizes system improvements focusing on features that will be helpful to users at the beginning of the game.
We have also added features that can increase the satisfaction of end content users, such as challenges and items to be registered in the encyclopedia. For the remaining elements, in addition to independent planning, we selected tasks that could be developed and introduced immediately within a realistic time frame within July or August from the feedback received and added them to the roadmap as well.

Although it's still not enough so far, I'd like to express my sincere gratitude to those who have always enjoyed the game and supported and promoted it.
As this is a game made and planned with love, even if it is not an AAA game, we will add fun content and make up for any shortcomings so that it can remain as a good memory.

notes.notes:
We present a development roadmap for June 2024.

We will try our best to develop the game as best as possible so that it can be developed further.
Although it may not be all of the roadmap, some elements were reflected by adding content or features requested by users.

(Item/Construction)
1. Addition of some rare (difficult to make directly and obtainable under special circumstances) items

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Map system for the interior of the castle (including Hanyangseong)

(balance)

*In addition to the roadmap, we will continue to fix bugs and add convenience.

notes.title: Development roadmap for February-March 2024
notes.notes:
We present the expected development roadmap for February and March.
We will try to develop it as well as possible this month.
We will be updating content-focused in March.

(Content/System)
1. Dolsoe main story
2. Encyclopedia (historic site) system
3. Character customization system
(The character customization system will be applicable to multi-participating users or after completing the main quest to avoid any confusion in the Dolsoe story.)
4. NPC companion system
5. Evasion (dash) function
6. Improvement so that there is no inventory burden on currency (commercial notification)

(Item/Construction)
1. Add some architectural elements
2. Added some costumes and armor
3. Add some weapons
4. Addition of new weapons and materials such as crossbow and gunpowder weapons
5. Improved functionality and added items to allow you to roast grains on a bonfire
6. Additions or adjustments to ingredients that cannot be made in the current recipe or are difficult to obtain.

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Insufficient combat/hitting/sound improvement
2. Changed some UI to be a little more intuitive
3. Improvement of some natural features
4. Improved map convenience

(feature)
1. Addition of Hanyangseong Fortress (updates will be added after part of the interior is revealed)
2. Addition of historic sites (will be added mainly to locations with few historical sites)
3. Addition of some sub-dungeons (we plan to allow users to experience similar boss patterns from the main story)
4. Added various paths between castles

(NPC/force)
1. Add foreign merchants
2. Add NPC types

(balance)
1. Increased attack speed of some weapons while lowering damage and reducing energy usage
(This is an update for the small fun and impact of combat. Overall, there will be little change in DPS)
2. Slight increase in durability of tools

*In this roadmap, we had many internal concerns and plans, but among these, we reflected the most requested requests from users in the roadmap as much as possible. There were other detailed requests, but please understand that not all users' difficulties were reflected.
*Generally, even if the roadmap is presented in advance, there may be slight changes or delays in the roadmap depending on the development team's circumstances, but we will try to achieve most of the goals by March as much as possible.

We will continue to develop as before. thank you

notes.title: Development roadmap for November 2023
notes.notes:
We present the expected development roadmap for November.
We will try to develop it as well as possible this month.

(Content/System)
1. Add minigame
2. Addition of Dolsoe main story and scenario
3. Addition of special product system for trade
4. Add sub mission

(Item/Construction)
1. Addition of various instruments and scores and application in-game
2. Add several books
3. Added various costumes and armor
4. Add some furniture
5. Add architectural elements
6. Addition of multiple specialty items

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Intuitively improved interface design and UX
2. Added help for various interfaces
3. Modification of combat methods and animations for various weapons
4. Show markers on the map
5. Direction indication of artificial features
6. Auto-running function
7. Graphics optimization for world trees
8. Add appropriate identity icons for each outfit
9. Warning message about being hungry or thirsty
10. Reconstruction function of the fish trap


(feature)
1. Add large-scale castle
2. Addition of Seodang building
3. Add historic sites
4. Improvements to special island areas
5. Added train station
6. Added some castles and paths between them to make it easier to find castles when you don't have a map.
7. Added fishing village
8. Adjusted the unnatural size of the lake and the phenomenon of digging too deep.

(NPC/force)
1. Medal, station owner added
2. Add specialty store owner
3. Add group/collective NPCs and patterns

(Balance)
1. Adjustment of research level limit for items
2. Adjustment of some restrictions on construction/production level according to skill level
3. Vegetables reduce hunger and increase thirst quenching
4. Increased overall durability of items made of iron
5. Adjust seasons and weather

*Some work carried out in early November before being released to the roadmap was included.
*Generally, even if the roadmap is presented in advance, there may be slight changes or delays in the roadmap depending on the development team's circumstances, but we will try to achieve most of the goals by November as much as possible.

We will continue to develop as before. thank you

notes.title: July 2023 development roadmap
notes.notes:
We present the expected development roadmap for October.
We will try to develop it as well as possible this month.

(Content/System)
1. Add minigame
2. Addition of Dolsoe main story and scenario
3. Add dance/motion
4. Add seasons

(Item/Construction)
1. Addition of various instruments and scores and application in-game
2. Add several books
3. Addition of various weapons
4. Add some furniture
5. Add architectural elements
6. Add various dishes and ingredients

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Intuitively improved interface design and UX
2. Improvements to some of the character's basic joint positions and costumes
3. Display UI text of artifacts on the map
4. Added help for various interfaces
5. Improved convenience of some quests
6. Call function for raised horses
7. Improved readability of books
8. Support memory optimization for dynamic loading of some modeling and items
9. Progress in resource optimization of historic sites
10. Improved speed of load selection menu window
11. Added keyboard settings menu related to some keys

(feature)
1. Addition of world artifacts (temples, etc.)
2. Add mine
3. Add historic sites
4. Some improvements to external modeling of Hanyangseong Fortress
5. Improvement of unnatural light reflection of some natural features
6. Small village and some castle areas added
7. Support for paying money to enter the castle even if your rank is low

(NPC/factions)
1. In-game application of NPCs who sing, play musical instruments, or dance
2. Addition of monk forces and NPCs
3. Musical instrument and sheet music dealer
4. Add animal NPC

(Balance)
1. Increased need for skill and restrictions on construction/manufacturing depending on skill level
2. Slight increase in base running speed (uses slightly more energy in proportion to increased speed)
3. Movement speed limit while shooting spear/archery
4. Changed mining method (changed the use of pickaxes by grade more clearly)
5. Balancing thirst and hunger

In general, even if the roadmap is presented in advance, there may be slight changes or delays in the roadmap depending on the development team's circumstances, but we will try to achieve most of the goals by October as much as possible.

Likewise, we will continue to develop. thank you

notes.title: Development roadmap for August and September 2023
notes.notes:
We present the expected development roadmap for August and September. Until then, we will try to develop it as well as possible. Some plans that were not reflected in the previous July were included in this roadmap.

(Content/System)
1. Added mini game
2. Exhibition hall (test field)
3. Score system (used as an instrument item)
4. Dance/motion function
5. Stealth and detection
6. Part of game difficulty adjustment menu
7. Add key story and scenario
8. Actual Status Elevation
9. Satisfaction/dissatisfaction added (applied only when actual status rises)

(item/building)
1. Improved usability and addition of luggage or shoulder luggage
2. Add several books
3. Added several traditional Joseon instruments
4. Added various costumes
5. Add various weapons
6. Some furniture and exhibits

(Convenience/Optimization/Graphics)
1. Improved some light systems including engine update
2. Improved item research convenience
3. Improving the natural environment including grass
4. Improved character joints and clothing quality (shadows, etc.)

(feature)
1. Medium and large castles (currently there are only small castles)
2. Additional dungeons
3. Added some ruins

(NPC/Faction)
1. NPCs who sing and play instruments or dance
2. Reinforced response of NPCs to hostile actions and added various types
3. Learn Skills from NPCs
4. Interactions when pushed ashore

(multiplayer)
1. Develop single-player content to suit multiplayer (minigames, etc.)

As before, we also do the following side tasks:

1. Balancing work
2. Other Optimizations
3. Improving difficult UX
4. Bug patch

In general, even if the roadmap is presented in advance, the roadmap may change slightly or be delayed depending on the circumstances of the development team, but we will try to achieve most of the goals by September as much as possible.

We will continue to develop. thank you

notes.title: Korea Dynasty May-June 2023 development roadmap
notes.notes:
May-June 2023 development roadmap

In the last April roadmap proposal, almost content was added closer to the last day, so on this roadmap, we would like to propose developments with a little more leisure to fit the schedule.
*Things that exist in the system but will be reflected in the March-April roadmap that will be added are also applied.

(Content/System)
1. Minigames such as Yutnori
2. Detailed interface tabs for status and reputation
3. Imprisonment and Escape
4. Weather (Rain)
5. Cold and Cold
6. Various types of repetitive missions provided by base NPCs
7. Quick slot (inventory) space expansion

(item/building)
8. Added various costumes and armor
9. Added various weapons
10. Add various architectural elements
11. Add some dishes and ingredients
12. Added some furniture and exhibits
13. Added Joseon traditional musical instruments

(Convenience / Optimization / Graphics)
14. Some non-intuitive recipe integration
15. Modified the height of the overall abnormally high terrain to make it less steep
16. Relaxation so that the division of the terrain is not unnatural (terrain that came out in a straight line like a road)
17. Graphics restocking (some textures improved due to high optimization in March-April)
18. Development engine version upgrade

(feature)
19. Inside the Little Castles
20. Fishing villages (type of small villages)
21. Add various shops
22. Government Offices and Prisons
23. A starting place to run away from in the first tutorial scenario
24. Remodeling some low-quality ruins and adding new ruins
*The reasons or purposes for which historic sites are needed will be developed in the next roadmap.

(NPCs)
25. Neutral NPCs of various types and functions
26. Added various enemy NPCs
27. Add some animal NPCs

As before, we also do the following side tasks:

1. Balancing work
2. Other Optimizations
3. Improving difficult UX
4. Bug patch

In general, even if the roadmap is presented in advance, there are cases where the priorities change slightly due to the reflection of players' suggestions, or new content development may be added, so we are not sure, but we want to achieve most of the above goals by June as much as possible. .

We will continue to develop. thank you

notes.title: Advance Notice on Lake and Durability
notes.notes:
Regarding the next update, it is judged that it can affect the game,
I would like to give a prior notice because it may cause inconvenience to some players.
We apologize in advance for any inconvenience caused.

1. There will be several updates about rivers and lakes.

While improving the slightly out of place rivers and unnatural parts,
We'll be working on tweaking several rivers a bit more and adding a few more.
Therefore, there may be changes in the topography, so please refer to those who have built houses near the river.

2. There will be a durability modification function, and the value will decrease according to durability.

There will be repair functions that can modify the durability of NPCs that will be updated soon.
Likewise, there may be a decrease in value depending on durability. It might be useful for reference.
(Even if durability is very low, minimum values are guaranteed)

(Notice mentioned earlier)
3. There will be a maximum building height limit.

There will be a prior height limit for construction. However, it will be limited to a level that is almost impossible to make in a normal way.

notes.title: March-April 2023 Development Roadmap
notes.notes:
March-April 2023 Development Roadmap

Since there were many things to deal with, the release of the roadmap in March was delayed, so we integrated it into April and posted the roadmap notice.
Korea Dynasty presents an integrated development roadmap for March-April.

(Content/System)
1. Some of the first main scenarios and tutorials in the game
2. Map and crafting system
3. Horse and Horse Riding System

(item/building)
4. Various costumes and armor
5. Various weapons
6. Add various architectural elements
7. Various dishes and ingredients
8. Various furniture and exhibits

(Convenience / Optimization / Graphics)
9. Options related to specifications such as optimization and graphics
10. Help function for beginners
11. Improved graphics (including some texture recovery due to extreme optimization)
12. Improving the natural environment

(feature)
13. Small level village outside the castle (with 3-5 buildings)
14. Dungeon-style hostile areas

(NPCs)
15. Neutral NPCs of various types and functions
16. Enemy NPCs with dynamic movements
17. Intuitive expression of gifts, fines functions and relationships with NPCs in an easy-to-understand manner
18. Officials guarding neutral NPCs such as police officers
19. Various animals

(Multi)
20. Multi-stabilization and general build integration
21. Management functions such as host (room manager) exit, chatting

As before, we also do the following side tasks:

1. Balancing work
2. Other Optimizations
3. Improving difficult UX
4. Bug patch
5. Some translation improvements

In general, even if we have presented a roadmap in advance, there are cases where priorities change slightly due to players' suggestions or new content development is added, but we want to achieve most of the above goals by April as much as possible.

Also, if the roadmap we presented is achieved early, we will try to open a small castle. It's not enough, but thank you for your continued support, and we will do our best.

notes.title: Korea Dynasty Co-op multiplayer has been released as a beta.
notes.notes:
hello. Korea Dynasty Co-op multiplayer has been released as a beta.

We'll walk you through the ability to turn steam multiplayer into an early access test build.

The unfortunate thing about releasing it right away is that the existing files and save/load are temporarily blocked due to stability issues, but we plan to do so next week with stability improvements.

Inconvenience and stability may still be low in multiplayer, so if you give us feedback on Discord, we will check and reflect it.

We will switch to the beta build for a while and integrate it with the regular build once stability improves to some extent.
Please note that there is a risk of data loss while on the network.

If you want to try it when the situation is stable, please wait a little longer and we will open the function so that you can do it in the full version without conversion.


# How to Join the Multi Beta Server

# 1. Beta participation must be enabled in Steam settings.

Select Steam in the upper left corner to open the settings window
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/b960382d7b4df74fc9126723196aa1e569a06936.png[/img]

# 2. Change to Beta Server in KoreaDynasty settings.

Right-click on KoreaDynasty in the library to open the Properties window.
Beta → Enter weloveplayer (all lower case letters) in the participation code and click the code check button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/57c648be7d241e99033126c69db6faf86cf0cf54.png[/img]

Choose the beta you want to join.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/4b2ea9ea2bd812cb787b30dfdee9056ccfb3f2e5.png[/img]

notes.title: We're really sorry for the delay in our multiplayer development.
notes.notes:
We're sorry we couldn't give you good news right away for those who are looking forward to the multiplayer feature we announced until February.

Despite my best efforts, I said that I would distribute it by February while developing it, but I couldn't afford it, so I couldn't disclose it as a result.

The development of the multiplayer function was completed today at noon, but there are fatal bugs such as stability issues (items disappearing, bugs where players sometimes do not appear when playing with 3 or more players, etc.), so they will be fixed and distributed.

Therefore, I wrote a post because I thought it was necessary to give a report on the development progress to the players who have been waiting with the word of apology.

The video below is a demonstration video that has been developed so far.





[previewyoutube=cxoiMFvVpu0;full][/previewyoutube]



The multiplayer host can import data from singleplayer and progress.

Multiplayer is operated in a Co-Op format, and invites by Steam friend invitation. We plan to gradually increase the number of people from 2 to 4 people. This is how the host manages all information. (The session is also terminated when the host closes the connection.)

Unfortunately, we'll have the bug fixed by next week to make it public beta, and the next time we write a multiplayer article again, we'll show you the actual results.

Lastly, I would like to apologize once more, and I will continue to develop it in parallel with the rest of the content and features.

notes.title: Korea Dynasty February 2023 development roadmap
notes.notes:
February 2023 development roadmap

It has been 4 weeks since Korea Dynasty was launched.
Although it was a short time, a lot has changed.
In the meantime, thank you for your continued interest in the Korea Dynasty.

Multiplayer is a difficult task to produce in a short time, but we are preparing steadily, and we will make sure to develop even the minimum function by the end of February, and from March, we will make the Korea Dynasty a game that can be enjoyed with friends.

As announced, in February, including multiplayer
We would like to present the roadmap below.

1. Co-op cooperative multiplayer with minimal features (2-4 player beta client planned initially)
2. Reducing the memory/CPU usage of architecture
3. Reduced stuttering when moving terrain
4. Storage box for items
5. Overall unnatural terrain improvements
6. Herbal medicines that can restore physical strength and stamina
7. A variety of furniture to decorate your home
8. Add other NPCs or discovered artifacts (buildings, caves, etc.)
9. Improvement of player combat mechanics
10. Create more types of costumes
11. Craft more types of weapons
12. Craft more dishes and ingredients
13. More construction crafting
14. Various animals
15. Improving the natural environment and optimizing it, such as adding the size and variety of grass, trees, and stones
16. Enhanced NPC AI
17. Minimal change in relationship between player faction and external forces according to actions
18. Give each NPC a first and last name
19. Books to read
20. Farming System Improvement and Variety of Seeds

As in January, the following incidental work will also be carried out.
1. Balancing work
2. Other Optimizations
3. Improving difficult UX
4. Bug patch
5. Add a few languages
6. Improved graphics

There are only two weeks left until March. Since we don't have enough time, we'll try to make as many features and contents as possible (plus other functions and contents if we can afford it).

In addition, Korea Dynasty is developed based on a set plan and goal, but since it is a game that creates content with players, some goals may change depending on the urgent needs of players, but we will try to produce the features presented as quickly as possible.

Then, in March, we will focus on content for the purpose of stabilizing and exploring multiplayer.

Thank you for your interest.

notes.title: 0.1.8 Rollback history and resolution
notes.notes:
In patch 0.1.8, there was a problem that the building data loading function was partially damaged and could not be loaded.

The reason for this is that the id referred to when saving the developed building was changed and two phenomena overlapped that did not handle exceptions for it.

It's a bug that's hard for developers to keep in charge of, and shouldn't be.
We recently added a development team member to speed up development, and there was a communication mistake in the process of urgent recruitment, which caused a loading bug.

There is a high probability that the team will be recruited in the future, and there is no guarantee that this will not happen.

1. Requested exception handling when loading items and building DBs that are prone to fatal mistakes.
2. We built a test environment and set to create each situation that developers can verify so that bugs do not occur during future updates, and instructed the tests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/f8c267706c83a250301dcf648d8359bb7651664e.png[/img]
building test environment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340519/ecafff7ac7fdd433c9e3f06dd67a6f8b476af56a.png[/img]
NPC test environment

3. Even in the worst case, in order to quickly roll back (if it is serious) or do an emergency patch right away, upload the build data in the morning instead of working on the day and uploading it at night after testing. Unless there is a special reason, it is recommended to update during working hours so that the patch is possible.
4. Up to 100 autosaved data will be saved every 5 minutes. (I will reduce the number when it stabilizes later.)
5. We will prioritize the development of creating multiple save slots and adding the ability to load a large number of autosave data.

This time, instead of updating, we will prioritize the 1,2,3 tasks inside the countermeasure meeting and execution + internal.

Lastly, we apologize for the sense of collapse and loss that data almost disappeared.
We will pay more attention and be careful.

notes.title: Korea Dynasty 0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Korea Dynasty 0.1.1 Update[/h1]

Hello. This is the Korean Dynasty. We have reflected the requested feedback and modified it so that it does not interfere with the game as much as possible. We are very sorry that smooth play was hindered, and we will try to make a better game by quickly reflecting player feedback. thank you.


[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Simplify the logging effect[/h2]

- Simplified the effect of creating unnecessary pieces of wood and disappearing to the ground.

[h2]Improved mining effect[/h2]

- Increased the size of stones and ores to make items more visible.
- Reduced the retention time of mining byproducts.

[h2]Player Manipulation[/h2]

- Improved the unnatural walking motion when moving from a high slope to a low direction.

[h2]Improved research tech tree[/h2]

- Changed “Stone Ax”, which was a research item, to a basic item.

[h2]Item improvements[/h2]

- The image of the tree branch has been replaced.
- Modified the installed processing table and work table so that they do not fall over.

[h2]Balance[/h2]

- Correction and recovery amount buff so that it automatically recovers when hunger is over 75% in status
- Increased the drop rate of branches that can be gathered.
- Increased the drop rate of ore items.
- Increased the drop rate of wood pieces.

[h2]UI/UX[/h2]

- Improved the ability to close all UI windows through the ESC key.
- Added a UI that displays east, west, south, and north so that you can know the direction.
- The UI of the workbench has been intuitively improved.

[h2]Vegetation Balance[/h2]

- The spawn rate has been lowered because mushrooms are showing too much compared to other gatherings.

[h2]Sound[/h2]

- Removed BGM that sounds especially loud in random BGM.

[h2]Ability Changes[/h2]

- Among the stats, the currently unused stealth has been disabled.
- Increased the upper limit of the required value and grade of the ability.

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

- Fixed so that players can re-position themselves on the terrain when they fall below it abnormally.
- Fixed a bug where the BGM was cut off while playing.
- Fixed a bug that could not be loaded from the saved location.
- Fixed a bug where campfires were burning from the time they were placed.
- An issue where animals and bandits do not move properly on slopes has been alleviated.
- Fixed to not encounter bandits when resurrected.
- Fixed a bug where Rogues would not attack players when revived.

notes.title: January 2023 development roadmap
notes.notes:
January 2023 development roadmap

Thank you for your continued interest in the Korea Dynasty!

Currently, Korea Dynasty is on an early access discount, and there are only basic game functions, but we recognize that many improvements and updates are needed to meet gamers' eye level.

In addition to basic game UX and balancing, we are looking to add content and goals to survive, and we plan to add the following elements by the end of January.

1. Added thief stronghold and hunter
2. Small neutral civilian buildings and NPCs
3. Improved animation and attack range, such as basic attacks
4. More types of animals and AI
5. Fishing
6. Add clothes type
7. More ingredients can be found in the field
8. Add more architectural elements
9. Necessity and Addition of Abilities

Besides that, of course, we also do the following:
1. Balancing work
2. Optimization
3. Improving UI/UX
4. Other small bug fixes
5. Add a few languages, Translate upgrade
6. Improved graphics

In February, we'll be adding Steam co-op multiplayer that all gamers have been waiting for.
Thank you for your interest.
